business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides book printing and print management services and owns a publishing segment through Quarto.

segments.name: Printing
segments.source: Annual Report 2024 Note 6 Segment information, p.73

segments.name: Publishing
segments.source: Annual Report 2024 Note 6 Segment information, p.73

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time printing income and publishing income from customers; no customer contributed more than 10% of 2024 revenue.
business_notes: 2024 revenue was HK$2,668.6 million, split into printing income HK$1,738.4 million and publishing income HK$930.2 million.
Management said about 40% of Quarto's 2024 profit came from non-recurring items.
Printing demand benefited from inventory replenishment and rush orders before possible tariff changes.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow covered parent net profit in 2022-2024, but 2022 benefited from large working-capital release and publishing requires recurring pre-publication spending. 2024 trade receivables increased and Quarto profit included non-recurring items, so owner cash profit is haircut despite strong headline cash conversion.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2024 consolidated statement of profit or loss, p.38
Annual Report 2024 consolidated statement of financial position p.39 and Note 20 p.90
Annual Report 2024 Note 22 Bank borrowings p.92
Annual Report 2024 consolidated statement of cash flows p.43

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by parent company versus each operating subsidiary, so cash detachability uses a group-level haircut.
Annual report does not disclose a precise minimum operating cash requirement; owner earnback analysis estimates it from scale, operating cost and working-capital volatility.
The report says about 40% of Quarto's profit came from non-recurring items but does not quantify the consolidated group impact.
